_note: facts-factory tags. Every topic and published video uses only these values. Add a new value here first, never invent it ad hoc. npm run plan:check enforces it.

hook_type.contradiction: Opens with two things that should not fit together; the video explains how they do
hook_type.question: Opens with a question the viewer wants answered
hook_type.number: Opens with a concrete number (must be in the fact sheet)
hook_type.myth_bust: Opens by attacking a common belief
hook_type.mystery: Opens with an unexplained event, the answer comes in the twist
hook_type.demo: Engine test, not a real episode

derived_fields.hook_words: word count of the hook text
derived_fields.hook_has_number: true if the hook contains a digit
derived_fields.hook_is_question: true if the hook ends with a question mark
derived_fields.weekday: 0-6 from published_at in the audience time zone

_controlled_note: During the explore phase these stay fixed so that differences come from topic and hook.
_visual_note: doodle is the only visual of this account. Old scene types stay in the engine but are not used by topics.
